text: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation is a listed company whose largest shareholders are asset managers such as Vanguard, BlackRock and State Street. Its 2026 proxy statement lists two owners of 5% or more of its common stock: BlackRock, Inc. (9.0%) and State Street Corporation (5.3%).
